text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hotpath GPU pool saturation detected. 429 spike on /v1/generate. 429_rate=18% over 5m. queue_len=4200. auto-escalate -> incidents channel. link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/2345678901
oncall_jess: I'm on it. Paging SRE and infra. Who's on the runtime side?
sre_mateo: looking. metrics: hotpool-3 (nv100) at 100% GPU mem, hotpool-4 at 98%. overall queue 4.2k, avg latency increased from 120ms -> 2.1s. tokenbucket drops at tier=prod: refill_rate ~ 500 tk/s, burst 1000, seeing big bursts from a single customer. 429s are tokenbucket rejects + queue backpressure.
eng-runtime_ash: autoscaler appears stuck. saw repeated logs: `scaleLoopSkipped: at maxNodes` but our configured maxNodes=8 and we currently have 8 provisioned, but metric shows available pods unhealthy. Also leader lock log shows frequent `failed to acquire resyncLock` from 03:12:17. suspect autoscaler lock contention and kube quota on the account.
infra-ops_lee: confirmed. GCE quota for GPUs is soft-limited for the project. Manual quota bump request pending (ticket #QT-8812) but not approved yet. We can do a manual override to spin up preemptible nodes if acceptable.
oncall_jess: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce tokenbucket refill for prod tier to slow incoming bursts 2) temporarily route new requests to fallback model (lower-gpu) for non-SLO customers 3) manual warm of 2 preemptible nodes to relieve queue 4) if 429s drop, follow-up to fix autoscaler lock. I'll coordinate.
eng-runtime_ash: to bump tokenbucket small change (applied in runtime config):
```
rate_policies:
  prod:
    refill_per_sec: 300  # from 500
    burst: 600           # from 1000
```
Applying now via rictl. This will throttle peak bursts but keep steady throughput.
deploy-bot: config-deploy started by eng-runtime_ash: `deploy/configs/ratepolicy/prod@sha=6a7f` - rollout 5% -> 100% over 3m.
sre_mateo: after 90s: 429_rate -> 11%, queue 3.1k. Good direction. But still seeing long-tail saturations from a small set of API keys. Listing top offenders: key-abc123 (28%), key-def456 (12%).
product_emanuel: which customers map to those keys? we need a quick customer impact summary for CS/AE.
oncall_jess: key-abc123 = Acme Payments (critical), key-def456 = BetaCorp (non-critical). Re-routing rule: any requests flagged `customer_tier!=enterprise` will be routed to model-small fallback. Applying route override now: `route set --path /v1/generate --if customer_tier!=enterprise --model redwood-small-v1`
eng-runtime_ash: route change applied. Also kicked off manual scale: `infra scale-pool --pool hotpath-3 --count +2 --type preemptible` -> provisioning started.
infra-ops_lee: note: preemptible spin up will take ~90-120s. I'm authorizing increased GPU quota temporarily for autoscaler to reach 10 nodes. Creating ephemeral quota grant.
sre_mateo: 4m after tokenbucket tweak + routing + scale: 429_rate=4.8%, queue=900, latency trending back to 180ms. Partial mitigation working.
oncall_jess: great. I'm handing off to infra-ops_lee for scale watchdog and eng-runtime_ash for autoscaler debug. I'll stay available for comms and customer updates. :thumbsup:
eng-runtime_ash: quick debug notes: leader resync failure traced to a race in the lock renewer under heavy GC. Pushing a small fix to backoff renew attempts and to make the lock TTL longer. Patch: `runtime/locking: backoff 200ms -> 1s; TTL 10s -> 30s`. Will open PR and stage to canary.
infra-ops_lee: preemptible nodes are up, hotpool now at 10 nodes. Autoscaler still reporting maxNodes=8 in controller config; manual override necessary. I applied temporary controller override `--max-nodes=12` to allow scale out.
sre_mateo: monitoring: request 429s now <1% on p95, latency stable. reclaiming queue workers as nodes registered.
oncall_jess: customer comms: pinged CS with initial impact note: "Acme Payments experienced increased 429s and latency for ~14 minutes. We routed traffic and scaled capacity; issue mitigated. ACME ticket #AC-2342. SRE investigating root cause and timeline."
deploy-bot: rollout complete: config-deploy prod ratepolicy at sha=6a7f -> success.
oncall_jess: timeline + immediate action summary for post-incident notes:
- 03:12:18 alert: GPU hotpool saturation, queue 4.2k, 429s 18%
- 03:13:05 applied tokenbucket throttle (refill -> 300/s, burst -> 600)
- 03:13:45 applied route override for non-enterprise to fallback model
- 03:14:10 manual scale: +2 preemptible nodes; infra increased controller maxNodes temporarily to 12
- 03:16:40 queue down to 900, 429s <5%
- 03:20:00 stable; handed to infra/runtime for follow-up
Action items (owners):
- eng-runtime_ash: PR to fix lock renewer/backoff and adjust lock TTL; include load-test (due EOD)
- infra-ops_lee: follow up on quota bump request and make preemptible playbook (due tomorrow)
- sre_mateo: run traffic replay against canary with new tokenbucket settings to measure false positives (due EOD)
- oncall_jess: draft customer-impact note and coordinate with CS (due in 1h)
Please add anything I missed.
product_emanuel: add: review product routing policy tradeoffs for non-enterprise fallbacks; ensure SLAs documented.
eng-runtime_ash: adding note: will also add metrics around lock acquisition failures to alert earlier.
oncall_jess: closing thread for now; reopen if 429s spike again. :eyes:
